newsitem.title: UK: Offer opens competition study of Yorks deal.
newsitem.headline: Offer opens competition study of Yorks deal.

text.p: British electricity industry regulator Offer said on Tuesday it would be seeking comment from parties with views on the competition aspects of yesterday's 1.5 billion stg deal for a U.S. consortium to buy Yorkshire Electricity Group Plc.
Offer's invitation to comment is the first stage of a regulatory review process in which it acts as a specialist adviser to the Office of Fair Trading, the national competition regulator.
Comments should be received by March 3, Offer said in a statement.

American Electric Power Co Inc and Public Service Co of Colorado said on Monday they had made their agreed offer for Yorkshire, one of Britain's last independent regional electricity companies (Recs), to create trans-Atlantic synergies in power supply, technology and generation.
